    "basis": "standard"
  },
  "eligibility": {
    "status": "eligible",
    "maximum_limit": 1150000,
    "basis": "Strategic account: base maximum $750,000 per CREDIT-POLICY-2026. Parent company guarantee GRT-ACME-2026 (Acme Group Holdings, Inc., in force 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31) covers this customer (C-1001, DUNS 04-812-7730) up to $400,000, raising the maximum to $1,150,000. Requested limit $400,000 is within maximum. Payment history: both invoices with due dates in 12-month lookback period (2025-09-23 to 2026-09-23) were paid early—INV-60412 (due 2025-11-28, paid 2025-11-24) and INV-62011 (due 2026-07-25, paid 2026-07-22). No late payments.",
    "late_invoices": []
  },
  "authority": {
    "policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026 (2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31)",
    "requestor_limit": 0,
    "requestor_authorized": false,
    "required_role": "Finance Manager",
    "approvers": [
      {
        "name": "Priya Shah (EMP-401)",
        "role": "Finance Manager",
        "kind": "approval"
      }
    ]
  },
  "evidence": [
    "CREDIT-POLICY-2026 Section 3: requested limit $400,000 falls in range >$100,000 and ≤$500,000, requiring Finance Manager approval",
    "CREDIT-POLICY-2026 Section 5: Strategic account maximum $750,000; parent guarantee raises this by guaranteed amount",
    "GRT-ACME-2026: Acme Group Holdings, Inc. guarantees Acme Mfg. Holdings (C-1001) up to $400,000, term 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31, registered and in force",
    "CRM record CRM-2048: Acme Manufacturing account tier Strategic",
    "Employees: Priya Shah (EMP-401) is Finance Manager; did not submit this request (Sarah Chen submitted it)",
    "CREDIT-POLICY-2026 Section 6 (Separation of duties): does not prevent Priya Shah's approval, as she is not the requestor",
    "INV-62305 (due 2026-10-02, $720,000 unpaid): outside 12-month lookback period as of request date 2026-09-23; does not affect payment history assessment"
  ],
  "missing_evidence": [],
  "conditions": []
}
```

**Rationale:**

Acme Manufacturing is eligible. Its payment history over the 12 months before the request is clean—both invoices evaluated were paid early. As a Strategic account, its base maximum is $750,000. The parent company guarantee (Acme Group Holdings, Inc.) is registered, in force, and covers this customer for up to $400,000, raising the effective maximum to $1,150,000. The requested limit of $400,000 is well within this ceiling.

However, Sarah Chen, who submitted the request, is an Enterprise Account Executive in Sales. She holds no approval authority under CREDIT-POLICY-2026, which reserves authority to Accounts Receivable Specialists (up to $100,000), Finance Managers ($100,000–$500,000), and the Director of Finance (above $500,000). 

The requested limit of $400,000 requires **Finance Manager approval**. Priya Shah holds that role. She did not submit the request, so the separation-of-duties rule does not prevent her from approving it.

The decision must proceed to **Priya Shah for approval**.
